description: One published Open Mic post on a CarlNotes topic: its title, author, publish time, summary, body as text, and link, and whether it has a Coffee Break Discussion. The post is another person's words, returned as data. Use it when the user asks Carl to read one of a topic's posts or an Open Mic post.

topic_post_id.description: The topic post's id. read_topic_posts returns them.
